ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.name: Anthropic API Key
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: REQUIRED. Anthropic API key that powers the AI agent (sk-ant-...). Get one at https://console.anthropic.com. The app will not start without it.

PORT.name: Gateway Port
PORT.description: HTTP gateway port. Must stay 18789 — it matches the Railway domain target port configured in this template.

CLODDS_TOKEN.name: Gateway API Token
CLODDS_TOKEN.description: Optional secret token for gateway API access. Recommended for public deployments. Leave empty to allow unauthenticated local API access.

WEBCHAT_TOKEN.name: WebChat Token
WEBCHAT_TOKEN.description: Optional auth token required by the built-in WebChat client. Leave empty for open WebChat access.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.name: Telegram Bot Token
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather to enable the Telegram channel. Leave empty to skip (WebChat works without any channel).

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.name: Discord Bot Token
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Discord bot token to enable the Discord channel. Leave empty to skip.
